name: Unidentified B1-series battle droid (Jod Na Nawood)
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified B1-series battle droid (Jod Na Nawood)
description: An B1-series battle droid of the Separatist Droid Army was left deactivated since the Clone Wars in a droid repair shop on the asteroid Port Borgo around 9 ABY. While looking for the droid SM-33, the pirate Jod Na Nawood activated the B1-series battle droid to check if it was SM-33. Upon being activated, the droid asked if they had won before their head fell off and they deactivated.
